thread:
mel: Kicking off the canary for release/optimize-2026.03.17 at 18:30 PT. Will route ~5% traffic to canary. Need two people to own smoke checks for the next 10m. Rolling window is 30m.

devon: On it — i'll watch model latency + error spikes. Can check /health and token cost dashboard.

zara: I'll do inference correctness samples and the prompt routing sanity set. Post examples to this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for release/optimize-2026.03.17 (canary_id=c-20260317-42) :rocket:

mel: Quick checklist: 1) confirm canary pods ready 2) run lightweight smoke script 3) validate p50/p95/p99 and 5xx < 0.5% 4) run 10 canonical prompts across model variants 5) confirm logs no new errors.

devon: pods are Ready. Running smoke script now:```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq .status
./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --target canary
```

zara: Posting a few sanity samples: 
- "Summarize quarterly revenue change in two bullets" -> output looks good, no hallucination.
- "Translate legal clause to plain english" -> small formatting weirdness on bullet 2. saving snippet.

mel: Noted formatting glitch. If it persists after 10m we can toggle ff `format-normalizer-off`. Devon, what's the latency right now?

devon: p50=72ms, p95=180ms, p99=420ms. Error rate 0.12% (within target). Token cost per request ~0.0032. No new 5xx. :thumbsup:

sre-desk: Can you also watch the KV cache hit rate? If hits drop below 60% we might see cost/regression. Alerts set for 50%.

mel: Copy. Zara — can you re-run the 10 canonical prompts but with the larger context (~2k tokens) to validate KV cache behavior?

zara: Re-running with longcontext set. Small increase in p95 to 220ms, p99 460ms. Cache hit 71%. Outputs look okay aside from that one bullet formatting.

devon: Running targeted log grep for "unsupported-quantization-fallback" in canary logs:```bash
journalctl -u canary-c-20260317-42 -o cat | grep quantization
``` — no occurrences.

mel: Good. Rollback plan ready? If anything crosses thresholds we revert to previous stable tag. Rollback command:```bash
redwoodctl rollout undo --to stable-20260310 --target canary
```

sre-desk: Rollback runbook linked: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary-rollback. Pager on-call engaged if we hit 5xx > 1% for 5m.

devon: Small error spike at 18:38 PT — transient 429s from a single region (us-west-2). Wasolated to a routing backend and auto-fallback handled it. Error burst lasted ~45s. No user impact seen.

mel: Thanks. Keep watching for 10 more minutes. If we get sustained 429 or p99 > 600ms, we start rollback.

zara: Formatting glitch reproduced when the input contains trailing HTML entities. I pushed a tiny hotpatch to sanitize that path (branch: hot/fix-html-escape). Will push to canary only if spike/rollback thresholds clear.

devon: Metrics steady now, p99 back down to 410ms, errors 0.15%. Recommend promoting after 30m if no other regressions.

mel: Agreed. Action items:
- devon: keep metrics watch for 30m and call rollback on sustained breach
- zara: prepare canary-only hotpatch PR and small test harness
- sre-desk: keep pager and KV cache alert tuned

mel: Thanks all — ping here when you see anything unusual. Otherwise i'll schedule the promo at 19:00 PT. :eyes:
